description: A change to a paid booking, which no tool can make directly: a name on a ticket goes through the airline, and new dates or flights are re-booked by Vuelo's team. Sends the change typed, so the team acts on exactly what the traveller wants, and returns a ticket reference and reply time to tell them. Nothing changes until the team does it, so never say it has. kind passenger_details: passenger (position, from 1), field (name, date_of_birth, title or gender) and new_value (a name exactly as on the passport, or YYYY-MM-DD). kind dates: new_from and new_to. kind flight: which (outbound or return) and new_value. kind special_request (a request to the hotel): request (late_check_in, early_check_in, accessibility, cot, connecting_rooms, bed_type, dietary or other), new_value for a time or bed (e.g. 'arriving 23:30', 'twin beds') and notes; the hotel decides, so say it has been asked for, never that it is confirmed. kind room or other: notes. Before paying, use update_travellers or book again instead. By the Vuelo reference (VU-...) and the email or mobile it was booked with.

request.description: For kind special_request: what to ask the hotel for.

email.description: The email the traveller booked with.

mobile.description: Or the mobile on the booking, instead of the email.
